app.title: 🎛️ Synapse Music V12 Studio

dataset.title: 📊 Dataset Explorer
dataset.search_value_placeholder: Enter keys or index (leave empty for random)
dataset.search_value_info: Keys: exact match, Index: 0 to dataset size-1
dataset.use_src_info: Check to use the source audio from dataset

service.title: 🔧 Synapse Service Configuration
service.checkpoint_info: Select a trained Synapse Music checkpoint file (full path or filename)
service.model_path_info: Select the Synapse Music model configuration (auto-scanned from checkpoints)
service.lm_model_path_info: Select the Synapse Composer model checkpoint (auto-scanned from checkpoints)
service.backend_info: Select backend for Synapse Composer: vLLM (faster) or PyTorch (more compatible)
service.init_llm_info: Initialize the Synapse Composer model during service initialization
service.flash_attention_info_enabled: Enable Flash Attention for faster inference (requires flash_attn package)
service.flash_attention_info_disabled: Flash Attention is not available (flash_attn package not installed)
service.offload_cpu_info: Offload models to CPU when not in use to save GPU memory
service.offload_dit_cpu_info: Offload the Synapse generation model to CPU when not in use (requires Offload to CPU)

generation.task_type_info: Select the music generation or editing task
generation.instruction_info: Instruction is automatically generated based on the selected task
generation.track_name_info: Select a track for layer generation or extraction
generation.track_classes_info: Select multiple track classes for song completion
generation.lm_codes_info: Paste Synapse Composer audio-code hints for music generation
generation.mode_info: Simple: describe the song naturally. Custom: control the style, caption, lyrics and generation settings.
generation.simple_query_placeholder: Describe the song you want to create, e.g. 'an emotional cinematic rock song with powerful male vocals and a huge final chorus'. Leave empty for a random sample.
generation.simple_query_info: Describe the song, genre, mood, instruments, vocals, production style or other characteristics you want
generation.simple_vocal_language_info: Select preferred language(s) for lyrics. Use 'unknown' to allow any language.
generation.caption_placeholder: Describe genre, production, instruments, vocals, mood, tempo, energy and other musical characteristics...
generation.caption_info: Describe the style, genre, instruments, vocals, production and mood
generation.lyrics_info: Enter lyrics with optional song-structure tags
generation.vocal_language_info: Select the vocal language. Use 'unknown' for automatic detection or instrumental generation.
generation.keyscale_info: Examples: C major, F minor, G# minor
generation.inference_steps_info: Turbo models: up to 8 steps. Base models: up to 200 steps.
generation.guidance_scale_info: Controls how strongly supported Base models follow the music prompt
generation.seed_info: Use comma-separated seeds when generating multiple songs
generation.random_seed_info: Automatically generate a new seed for each generation
generation.audio_format_info: Select the format used when saving generated music
generation.shift_info: Timestep shift for Base models (1.0–5.0, default 3.0). Does not affect Turbo models.
generation.infer_method_info: ODE (Euler) is faster. SDE introduces stochastic sampling and may produce different results.
generation.custom_timesteps_info: Optional comma-separated values from 1.0 to 0.0, e.g. '0.97,0.76,0.615,0.5,0.395,0.28,0.18,0.085,0'. Overrides generation steps and timestep shift.
generation.lm_temperature_info: Higher values make Synapse Composer more varied and experimental
generation.lm_top_p_info: Nucleus sampling threshold (1.0 disables Top-P filtering)
generation.lm_negative_prompt_placeholder: Describe musical characteristics the Composer should avoid
generation.lm_negative_prompt_info: Negative Composer conditioning used when Composer Guidance Scale is greater than 1.0
generation.cot_metas_info: Allow Synapse Composer to generate structured musical metadata before generation
generation.cot_language_info: Language used by Synapse Composer during composition planning
generation.auto_score_info: Automatically calculate quality scores for generated songs
generation.auto_lrc_info: Automatically generate synchronized lyric timestamps for generated songs
generation.lm_batch_chunk_info: Maximum songs processed in each Composer batch (default 8; limited by GPU memory)
generation.codes_strength_info: Control how strongly Composer-generated music codes influence denoising
generation.cover_strength_info: Control how strongly the source audio influences Cover generation
generation.score_sensitivity_info: Lower values increase sensitivity (default 1.0). Controls how PMI is mapped to the 0–1 quality range.
